claims.statement: Rust .rs source authoring is the supported first-party path.
claims.scope: Rust source authoring with the documented Cargo, wasm32 target, and wasm-bindgen prerequisites.

claims.statement: Solid and Svelte adapters remain experimental.
claims.scope: Named Vite and Chromium fixtures only; no clean registry-consumer claim.

claims.statement: Webpack and Rspack Rust-file integrations are bounded alpha evidence.
claims.scope: Named Vue/React source-tarball fixtures; not a blanket bundler or browser claim.

claims.statement: The dedicated precompiled component-package builder is retired.
claims.scope: Authors own component packaging; this is not a supported zero-Rust consumer path.

claims.statement: SSR-rendered Rust DOM, hydration and slots are not supported.
claims.scope: Client-mounted islands and named SSR-safe host-container evidence are separate.

claims.statement: Additional language providers and browser IDE environments are research only.
claims.scope: No Go, Zig or browser Rust compilation support claim exists.
